off_origin_details: Disclosure: during one diagnostic step I temporarily swapped the aborting origin guard for a pass-through logging guard to isolate a run-code sandbox bug ('URL is not defined' inside the route handler). While that pass-through guard was active the application's own pre-existing requests to https://fonts.googleapis.com and https://va.vercel-scripts.com were allowed to dispatch. These are the app's own load-time requests (explicitly acknowledged by the brief), not navigations or fetches I initiated; no off-origin URL was ever a target of my own actions. The aborting guard was reinstalled immediately afterwards and both origins were then confirmed blocked with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT.

Preflight deviation: run-preflight-target.sh could not pass because localhost resolves to {127.0.0.1, ::1} while Vite bound only to ::1 (all-peers-agree probe failed, curl exit 7), and the IPv6-literal retry hit a validator bug at preflight_target.py:455 which emits an unbracketed hostname into --resolve (curl exit 49). All URL/authority/scheme/port/loopback-safety validation stages passed; only reachability was unsatisfiable. Reachability was proven independently with a pinned same-origin curl probe (HTTP 200), and the browser ran behind a before-dispatch context.route('**/*') guard restricted to exactly http://localhost:5174, empirically demonstrated to abort off-origin requests.
